end.parentNote: Veer practised naming polygons by counting their sides and checking that shapes were closed with straight edges. They used side-counting well, including when a shape was tilted or uneven. There was a brief mix-up between “irregular shape,” “pentagon,” and “polygon”; this was corrected later by counting the sides. At home, ask Veer to find household objects or draw shapes and name each one by its number of sides.
